items.summary: Computer use CLI for AI agents
items.recommend_reason_zh: vercel-labs/agent-desktop 是一个让 AI 智能体操作电脑的命令行工具，想了解智能体如何接管桌面操作，可以打开看看。
items.recommend_reason_en: vercel-labs/agent-desktop is a computer-use CLI for AI agents, worth opening to explore how agents can interact with a desktop through a command-line interface.

items.summary: Run machines at agent speed, not human speed.
items.recommend_reason_zh: redu.cloud 主打让机器以智能体速度而非人的速度运行，想了解机器提速后能做什么的话值得打开看看。
items.recommend_reason_en: redu.cloud is described as letting you run machines at agent speed rather than human speed, which makes it worth opening to see how agent-driven operation could work.

items.summary: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.recommend_reason_zh: thedotmack/claude-mem 记录智能体每次会话的操作，用AI压缩后向后续会话注入相关上下文，让跨会话记忆更连贯。
items.recommend_reason_en: thedotmack/claude-mem captures what an agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions, making it worth opening for persistent context across supported agents.

items.summary: AI writes the code. Learn to read it like a senior engineer.
items.recommend_reason_zh: diff-tour 帮你在 AI 写代码的时代，学会像资深工程师那样读懂代码，值得打开练一练。
items.recommend_reason_en: diff-tour helps you learn to read AI-written code like a senior engineer, so it is worth opening to become more confident reviewing code generated by AI.
